messages:
Priya: Hey @Ari — PR #9491 is blocked pending architecture review. Added the RFC link and SLO notes; can you give quick eyes? https://redwood.internal/rfcs/9491
Ari: Thanks — I'll scan now. Can you paste the SLO delta and the traffic split you'll use for canary?
Priya: SLO delta: ~0.2% increase on p99 tail under stress. Canary plan: 5% for 30m, then 25% for 2h, then 100% if metrics stable. CI: e2e + perf checks added.
Liam: Quick flag — this touches shard routing and the caching layer. Need an ops runbook and confirmation there's no DB schema work. @Kevin?
Kevin: No DB migration. Ops runbook added: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/pr-9491 — includes rollback steps and metrics to watch.
Ari: Can you link the exact RFC anchor for the design decisions? We need that in PR description to unblock.
Priya: RFC anchor: https://redwood.internal/rfcs/9491#design-decisions — also added a 3-line summary to the PR description. cc @Kevin
deploy-bot: CI status: all checks passed. Perf quick-run shows +0.1% p99 locally, attaching logs in the PR.
Kevin: LGTM modulo small docs nits. One request: add a one-line fallback policy to the RFC describing model variant switch on capacity failure.
Ari: Fallback policy looks reasonable. Please add the sentence and include canary thresholds (error rate <0.5%, p95 latency <350ms). After that I'll mark arch-ack.
Priya: Done — updated RFC and PR desc with fallback sentence and thresholds. Can we schedule a 1hr canary today at 16:00 PT? :calendar: 
Ari: I can do 16:00 PT. Arch-ack from me :white_check_mark: — you can proceed with the canary once ops confirms traffic shift window.
